objective: Add a capability registry to the Pi integration: each optional capability is one declarative entry that drives pi.features, the packages it installs, setup flags and TUI toggles, and doctor health, in a headless and a normal form.
scope: Worktree /home/user/holyagent-0.3.1-cap, branch release/0.3.1/feat/capabilities (cut from release/0.3.1/integration at 0.3.1).

Maintainer requirements (verbatim): "everything should be modular and easily upgradeable btw" and "btw we shall support both headless use and normal use, that's the point of capabilities, to modularly support systems". The model is holycodex v0.16.12's capability registry, mostly default-on; setup and doctor detect the system (display, OS, installed tools) to pick the form.

Read first: the capability research /home/user/holyagent/.git/holyagent/reports/assignment-0mw97bk3l-ykkf.md, and the seam map /home/user/holyagent/.git/holyagent/reports/assignment-0mw9hak7s-avpt.md (capability registry seams: config/schema.ts pi.features ~L158-170; config/packages.ts FEATURE_PACKAGES ~L10 and piPackages ~L32; pi/tools.ts toolArgs ~L151 and toolSettings ~L287; setup/pi-check.ts, setup/pi-install.ts, cli/setup.ts).

Registry entry fields: name, description, the Pi packages (exact pins from config/pi-packages.json) and optional MCP servers it adds, the skills it carries, applicability (root, specialists, or both), default on or off, system needs (what doctor checks), a headless form and a normal form (which may differ in packages or be unavailable), and a doctor health check. Keep the registry a data module so a later PR adds a capability by adding one entry.

Move the capabilities that exist today (what FEATURE_PACKAGES and pi.features cover now) onto the registry with unchanged behavior and defaults. Do not add the new 0.3.1 capabilities (just-bash, fff, browse, screen, Codex, auto-review): later PRs add them as entries.

Setup: a flag per capability (enable/disable) and a TUI toggle row per capability in the existing setup TUI, plus headless/normal detection with an override flag. Doctor: report each enabled capability's health and the detected form.
Pins stay in config/pi-packages.json moved by scripts/update-dependencies.ts (PI_PACKAGE_PINS); the registry references them and does not duplicate versions.

Update docs/pi, docs/usage.md and docs/components.md where they describe pi.features, setup flags or doctor output so they match; name any other doc that needs a change in the report instead of editing it.
